solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Behave badly and smash model Roman hero skipping about

parts.note: to smash something is to break it
the Model T was Ford's famous early car, so model gives T

indicators.note: skipping something means leaving it out, so a letter is dropped from the hero's name

parts.note: Hercules is the Roman name of the Greek hero Heracles
C stands for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: A wrecker smashes a statue of a Roman hero while dancing about, misbehaving thoroughly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skipping about' takes C (circa) out of HERCULES, leaving HERULES.
explanation.definitionFit: Behaving badly means flouting accepted standards of conduct, an idiomatic equivalent.

clue.text: Little one briefly left in cot chattered

indicators.note: said briefly, the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a little one is a baby

indicators.note: one piece sits within another here: left goes in the cot

parts.note: a cot is a small bed

explanation.surface: A toddler left alone in a cot babbled away to itself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' drops the last letter of the little one, and 'in' puts left inside the cot.
explanation.definitionFit: To babble is to chatter rapidly and incoherently, a close synonym.

clue.text: Found crack in prophet's faith at last

indicators.note: the crack goes inside the prophet's name, signalled by in

parts.note: Eli is the Old Testament prophet who taught Samuel; with the 's this gives ELIS
to have a crack at something is to have a stab at it

indicators.note: at last points to the final letter of the word faith

explanation.surface: A schism opens in the religion of some prophet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Found' looks like the past tense of find, but it is the verb meaning set up.
explanation.definitionFit: To found an institution is to set it up, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Show reverence long after King's born

indicators.note: after places the long piece behind the king and born pieces

parts.note: K is the chess and card abbreviation for king
nee, from French, introduces a woman's birth name
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for long or large

explanation.surface: Subjects have long been expected to bow down once a king's heir is born.
explanation.definitionFit: Going down on one's knees is a traditional gesture of respect or worship.

clue.text: Hospital always always admit fellow with allergy

parts.note: H is the map-sign abbreviation for hospital

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so the fellow goes inside the two always words

parts.note: ay (or aye) is an old word for always
ever means always, as in ever hopeful
F is the abbreviation for fellow, as in FRS

explanation.surface: A hospital that keeps admitting the same man with an allergy.
explanation.definitionFit: This seasonal condition is an allergic reaction to pollen.

clue.text: Some epic errors turn up in cooking instructions

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards
some of the words, a run of letters inside epic errors

explanation.surface: A few dramatic mistakes appear in a set of cooking directions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' picks EPICER from 'epic errors', and 'turn up' reads it bottom to top.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of directions for preparing a dish is exactly what the kitchen document is.

clue.text: After nearly fatal resistance soldier gets cold and listless

indicators.note: nearly means not quite all, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: lethal means fatal
R is the physics symbol for electrical resistance
GI is an American soldier
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: A soldier recovering from a near-fatal wound feels cold and drained.
explanation.definitionFit: Lethargic and listless both describe a sluggish lack of energy or enthusiasm.

clue.text: Relish a sexy dance

definitions.meaning: a spicy tomato-based sauce or condiment
a lively, sensual Latin American ballroom dance

explanation.surface: Someone enjoys a sultry dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a spicy Mexican sauce and a Latin American dance.

clue.text: Notice surrounding river rising fast

indicators.note: surrounding means the notice word goes around the river

parts.note: to spy something is to notice it

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the river's name is read upwards

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Scotland and another on the England-Wales border

explanation.surface: Someone notices the river rising quickly around them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' reads the river upwards, as this is a down clue, and 'surrounding' wraps the notice word round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Speedy and fast are straightforward synonyms for quick.

clue.text: Electricity supplier for artillery unit

definitions.meaning: a cell or set of cells storing electrical power
a group of heavy guns, or the soldiers manning them

explanation.surface: Looks like a power company tendering for the army.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an electric cell and an emplacement of big guns.

clue.text: Spooner's residence better for pet access

indicators.note: Spooner's signals swapping the opening sounds of the two words, after the Reverend Spooner

parts.note: a flat is a residence
to cap something is to better it

explanation.surface: A clergyman's home makes a better place for letting the cat in.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the openings of FLAT and CAP gives CAT and FLAP.
explanation.definitionFit: This hinged door panel lets a household animal come and go as it pleases.

clue.text: Description of first murder victim by lake

parts.note: L is the map abbreviation for lake
in Genesis Abel, killed by his brother Cain, is the first murder victim

explanation.surface: A report describes the Bible's first murder victim found beside a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A tag or name applied to something describes or classifies it.

clue.text: Communities plan a development including sea front area

indicators.note: including means the run of letters is held within the words communities plan a development

explanation.surface: Town councils draw up a development scheme that takes in the seaside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'including' signals the hidden run spanning communitiES PLAN A DEvelopment; 'sea front area' looks like part of the plan but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A promenade along the shore at a seaside resort is the area meant.

clue.text: Following initial destruction, gale gets mostly lower and dies down

indicators.note: following puts the gale piece after the initial letter
initial points to the first letter of destruction

parts.note: a gale is a strong wind

indicators.note: mostly means most of the word, so its last letter goes

parts.note: lower can mean less, as in of less height

explanation.surface: After causing early damage, a storm weakens and fades.
explanation.definitionFit: Dwindles means diminishes gradually, an idiomatic match for dies down.

clue.text: High-risk affair describing annoyance with America

indicators.note: to describe a circle is to draw round it, so the affair goes around the annoyance

parts.note: a do is a party or social affair
anger is strong annoyance

explanation.surface: An illicit relationship with an American irritant sounds risky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'describing' is used in its geometric sense of drawing round, as a compass describes a circle; 'affair' means a party, not a romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dangerous carries a high chance of harm, a close synonym.

clue.text: Grow old and conservative in New York office

parts.note: to age is to grow old

indicators.note: in places the conservative letter inside the New York abbreviation

explanation.surface: A conservative grows old in a New York office.
explanation.definitionFit: An agency is a business office providing a particular service.

clue.text: Baron, bafflingly popular with Queen, gives easy answer

indicators.note: bafflingly means in a confusing way, so the letters of baron are mixed up

parts.note: in means popular, as in the in crowd
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, Queen Elizabeth

explanation.surface: A baron, confusingly favoured by the Queen, has an obvious solution.
explanation.definitionFit: A decision so obvious it needs no thought is what the idiom describes.

clue.text: Certain quote brought up about politician has to be cut short

indicators.note: about means the reversed quote goes around the politician and the trimmed word
in a down clue brought up means read upwards

parts.note: to cite a passage is to quote it
MP is a Member of Parliament

indicators.note: cut short means the last letter is removed

explanation.surface: A quote raised about a politician is clipped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' reads the quote word upwards (ETIC), 'cut short' trims has to HA, and 'about' wraps the reversal round the politician plus HA.
explanation.definitionFit: Emphatic and certain both describe a firm, definite statement.

clue.text: Working with assistance close by

parts.note: on means working, as a switch is on
to give someone a hand is to assist them

explanation.surface: Someone working with help nearby.
explanation.definitionFit: On hand means available and nearby, an idiom for close by.

clue.text: Sit in gets hundreds supporting old university verging on penury

indicators.note: in a down clue supporting puts the hundreds below the old piece

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so CC is two hundreds

indicators.note: verging means the edges of the word penury, its outer letters

explanation.surface: A student sit-in protest draws hundreds at a broke old university.
explanation.definitionFit: To occupy a seat or place is to sit in it, a literal synonym.

clue.text: Cordial email sent off to secure taxi

indicators.note: to secure is to hold fast, so the rearranged letters enclose the taxi
the letters of email are sent off in a new arrangement

parts.note: a cab is a taxi

explanation.surface: A friendly email is sent to book a cab.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent off' makes AMILE from the email's letters, and 'to secure' has those letters hold the taxi inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Cordial and amicable both mean warm and friendly.

clue.text: Old stories regularly have sweetheart married before end

indicators.note: before puts the married piece ahead of the sweetheart

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: regularly picks the even letters of stories

parts.note: the heart of sweet is its middle letter, E

explanation.surface: Old tales usually have a sweetheart wed before the finish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'end' is the definition, not part of the wordplay: the extreme of something is its furthest point.
explanation.definitionFit: An extreme is the furthest point or limit, the very end of a range.

clue.text: One who minds about earth has a vocation

indicators.note: about means the carer goes around the earth

parts.note: a carer looks after, or minds, someone
E is the electrical abbreviation for earth

explanation.surface: A child-minder concerned for the planet has a calling.
explanation.definitionFit: A career is a lifelong occupation or calling, near-synonymous with vocation.

clue.text: Go round by parking at hotel to reach bike track

parts.note: to cycle is to go round in a circuit
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking
H is the abbreviation for hotel, and Hotel is H in the phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Circle the hotel car park to find the bike lane.
explanation.definitionFit: A dedicated lane or route for cyclists is the bike track meant.

clue.text: Husband in care of doctor's given rise to multiple notes

indicators.note: in puts the husband inside the care of letters

parts.note: c/o is the postal abbreviation for care of

indicators.note: in a down clue given rise to means the letters are read upwards

parts.note: DR is the abbreviation for doctor

explanation.surface: A husband in a doctor's care has caused several notes to be written.
explanation.definitionFit: A chord is several musical notes sounded together.

clue.text: Old lady's getting minimum of tax allowance

parts.note: gran is short for grandmother, an old lady

indicators.note: the minimum of a word is its smallest piece, here the first letter of tax

explanation.surface: A grandmother claiming the minimum tax allowance.
explanation.definitionFit: A grant is a sum of money allowed or awarded.

clue.text: Escalated muttered complaint

indicators.note: muttered points to how the word sounds when spoken

parts.note: grown means increased or escalated

explanation.surface: A grumbled complaint that keeps escalating.
explanation.walkthrough: The blog notes the ambiguity: either sense could be the definition, but GROAN fits complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: A groan is a moan of pain or complaint.

clue.text: Excite expert with very fine wine's finish

parts.note: a pro is an expert
OK means fine

indicators.note: finish points to the last letter of wine

explanation.surface: A connoisseur enthuses over the finish of a fine wine.
explanation.definitionFit: To provoke is to stir up or excite a reaction.

clue.text: Best to run trip with church

indicators.note: to trip is to stumble, so the letters of to run fall into a new order

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: The finest way to manage an outing with a church group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Best' looks like an adjective but is the verb meaning defeat.
explanation.definitionFit: To trounce a rival is to beat them soundly, a synonym for the verb best.

clue.text: Policeman's severe runs treated with drug from community medic

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector, a police officer; the 's is possessive
strict means severe

indicators.note: treated means processed or worked on, so the letters of runs are rearranged

parts.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A strict policeman's drug runs are dealt with by a local health worker.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain this nurse visits patients at home within a local area.
